mechanics.claim: The base non-empowered explosion damage is capped at 300 against non-champions.
mechanics.quote: dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, capped at 300 against non-champions

mechanics.claim: The total damage from an empowered Sapling and its two attachments is capped at 600 against non-champions.
mechanics.quote: The '''total''' damage is capped at 600 against non-champions.

mechanics.claim: Against minions, an empowered explosion deals full (100%) damage instead of the reduced 66.7% dealt to non-minion targets.
mechanics.quote: Against minions, the explosion deals 100% damage.

mechanics.claim: A target can only have two Saplings attached at once; further empowered explosions on an already-attached target refresh duration and only add a new Sapling if one has already exploded on them.
mechanics.quote: Targets can only be attached to two ''Saplings'' at a time; subsequent empowered ''Sapling'' explosions on a target will refresh the duration and only attach a ''Sapling'' if one has exploded on them already.

mechanics.claim: A normal Sapling's explosion is area damage (single instance to all nearby enemies), while an empowered Sapling's attached damage is persistent damage (separate ticking instances).
mechanics.quote: Applies {{tip|area damage}} from a normal ''Sapling'' and deals {{tip|persistent damage}} to enemies hit by an empowered ''Sapling''.

mechanics.claim: The cast itself only launches a destructible projectile; the actual Sapling unit and its effects occur only once it lands.
mechanics.quote: ''Sapling Toss's'' cast does not initially fling the actual ''Sapling'' unit but instead a ''Sapling''-like {{tip|projectile}} that can be destroyed by projectile-interception effects.

mechanics.claim: Casting a Sapling onto the same spot as an existing Sapling causes the new one to land offset rather than stacking.
mechanics.quote: ''Saplings'' cannot be stacked on top of each other; if ''Sapling Toss'' is cast to the same point as a ''Sapling'' currently on the ground, the new ''Sapling'' will move a short distance away from the existing one upon landing.
